parts.text: Edit this image: on the goalie mask on the ball, paint ONLY the TOP HALF of the mask (above the horizontal seam line) the same glossy retro purple as the top of the ball, like a purple retro goalie mask, keeping its holes, scratches and red marks. The bottom half of the mask stays bone white. IMPORTANT keep the mask shape, the purple button with white ring on the nose, the seam, the man, his vest, the gold axe and everything else exactly the same.
